subject: AWS Offer: legal-friendly product blurb + AMI tagging for co-sell
messages:
From: Liam Chen <liam.chen@amazon.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Listing <marketplace-listing@amazon.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Offer: legal-friendly product blurb + AMI tagging for co-sell

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the earlier intake. We did a quick pass on the draft listing and have two items blocking approval for co-sell and publish:

1) Product description/legal language: a couple of phrases imply we manage customer data ("we retain logs for 30 days") — AWS legal prefers neutral product statements (feature-focused, no commitments on retention/processing unless covered in contract). Can you provide a short alternate blurb (<= 400 chars) that's product-first?

2) AMI tagging / naming: to qualify for the ISV co-sell SKU we need the AMI and snapshot naming to include partner and build date, and a small CSV with tags. I attached the tagging checklist template — please return the filled CSV and the final AMI name.

Also looping in Sahil (CloudCorp) since you two discussed joint go-to-market. If you plan to enable co-sell for CloudCorp as a reseller, confirm entitlement contact and expected start quarter.

Attaching the tagging checklist for your convenience.

Thanks,
Liam
AWS Marketplace Onboarding
attachments: ami_tagging_checklist.csv

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Liam Chen <liam.chen@amazon.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Sahil Rao <sahil@cloudcorp.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 11:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Offer: legal-friendly product blurb + AMI tagging for co-sell

Liam — thanks for the clear notes. See answers and artifacts below.

1) Alternate product blurb (<=400 chars) — final candidate included and also in attached marketplace_copy_v3.docx: 
Redwood Inference delivers low-latency, cost‑efficient LLM inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Deploy via AWS Marketplace to get predictable throughput, automated scaling, and integrated tooling for observability and routing.

Notes: we removed retention/processing claims and replaced with product capabilities. If AWS legal wants a shorter one-line, we can compress further.

2) AMI naming & tags — per your checklist we will follow this convention: redwood-inference-ami-v1.2-20260830 and include these tags: Product=RedwoodInference, Component=InferenceRuntime, Build=20260830, Partner=CloudCorp (when relevant). I attached the completed ami_tagging_checklist.csv and the marketplace copy doc.

Co-sell / entitlement: Sahil — confirming CloudCorp will be listed as co-sell partner. Sahil, please confirm the contact for entitlement (name, email, and if you have a Partner Network ID). Once you confirm, we'll submit the aws_entitlement_form.pdf (attached) and route to your legal.

Action items (owners):
- Karthik: finalize AMI and upload AMI naming + CSV (in progress)
- Marissa: vet marketplace copy against marketing assets and finalize 1-line for UI (assigned)
- Laura: review pricing dimensions and SKU mapping for AWS offer (assigned)
- Sahil: confirm entitlement contact and Partner Network ID (action)

I attached marketplace_copy_v3.docx and the filled ami_tagging_checklist.csv.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Partnerships (Sales)
Redwood Inference
attachments: marketplace_copy_v3.docx; ami_tagging_checklist.csv

Thanks — quick inline notes and next steps: 

> Redwood Inference delivers low-latency, cost‑efficient LLM inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Deploy via AWS Marketplace to get predictable throughput, automated scaling, and integrated tooling for observability and routing.

This reads well. Two small asks from legal/comms:
- Prefer "predictable throughput" -> "predictable performance" (less operational claim)
- Remove the word "routing" (ambiguous for Marketplace UX)

If you send a 1-line variant we can slot it into the offer tile.

AMI / tags: the CSV looks good. Please ensure the AMI visibility is set to Public (or share with the AWS Marketplace account listed in the checklist) and include the exact AMI ID in the form. For co-sell: please complete aws_entitlement_form.pdf and have Sahil sign off. Once we receive the signed entitlement form + AMI ID + final 1-line blurb, we can mark the listing Ready for Marketplace QA. Typical QA turnaround is 3 business days.

I attached the entitlement form to this thread — will ping the Marketplace QA team once everything arrives.

Liam
